system.description:
You collect lightning into two massive spheres covering each hand before compressing them into globes the size of golf balls. You then mold the chakra turning them into two snakes of your description that coil around one another, before flying towards a target of your choice that you can see within range. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack, dealing 11d12 lightning damage. On a hit, the Lightning then explodes outwards in a 10-foot radius centering on the target creature. All other creatures within 10 feet of the target must make a constitution saving throw, being Dazed and Confused on a failed save.

Overcharge. You can select one additional creature to target, sending the second snake to the new targets location.
